# lost-sessions

> Recover Claude Code, Codex, Muse and OpenCode sessions that a reboot dropped:
> find the sessions that started before the last boot and that no session
> manager restores, then print their resume commands or reopen them in Herdr
> or Rex. Agents and session managers are plugins (pluggy, as in simonw/llm).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/smorinlabs/lost-sessions/blob/main/README.md): overview and installation
- [Plugin design](https://github.com/smorinlabs/lost-sessions/blob/main/docs/design/0006-lost-sessions-plugin-design.md): hookspecs, plugin contracts, data models, the CLI contract
- [Agent guidelines](https://github.com/smorinlabs/lost-sessions/blob/main/AGENTS.md): commands and rules for AI coding agents working in this repo
- [Changelog](https://github.com/smorinlabs/lost-sessions/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history (release-please managed)
